utilities.name: File / storage
utilities.description: See how much space tape, sounds, factory content and the system use. Shift + COM, then turn the blue encoder to FILE.

utilities.name: Scale mode
utilities.description: Play scales on the white keys. In synth mode, press T2 and hold Shift: white chooses the key, orange chooses the scale. Select OFF to play normally.

utilities.name: Snapshot naming
utilities.description: Name synth and drum snapshots with up to 12 letters or digits. Hold a sound-slot key, choose characters with blue and green, push blue to insert, and use the left arrow to delete. Press the same slot to save.

utilities.name: Tape undo / redo
utilities.description: Hold TAPE and press left to undo or right to redo recordings and tape edits. Keeps up to seven history levels across restarts; available history depends on free storage.

op1r_plugins.name: Granular

op1r_plugins.name: Clouds
op1r_plugins.description: Granular textures, after Mutable Instruments Clouds.

op1r_plugins.name: Reverb
op1r_plugins.description: Plate and hall reverb, after Mutable Instruments Elements.

op1r_plugins.name: Mixtur
op1r_plugins.description: Undertones below every key, after Oskar Sala's Mixtur-Trautonium. By ultralazr.

op1r_plugins.name: Arc
op1r_plugins.description: Duddell's singing arc from 1899: an unstable, buzzing oscillator with a second lamp to couple. By ultralazr.

op1r_plugins.name: Palme
op1r_plugins.description: Twelve tuned strings that ring along and turn into a gong, after the Ondes Martenot. Push orange for an endless drone. By ultralazr.

op1r_plugins.name: In a room
op1r_plugins.description: Every pass of the loop goes through a room, after Alvin Lucier's I am sitting in a room. By ultralazr.
